title: Biblical Research Unlocks — Waves 11–12
purpose: Plot the date on which the new Son-side and Tim/Father-side biblical structures were formally recognized, without backdating them into the older life events.

events.title: Son biblical deepening — Dan / Twin / Farmers / Gate / Grain
events.subject: Son / Thomas / Twin research
events.summary: A systematic Son-first sweep formally links several underdeveloped structures: Dan as both serpent and lion cub; Thomas/Twin beside death and tomb; Son of Man as ascent/descent locus; Son-of-Man glorification beside grain-death-fruit; tenant Farmers killing the beloved Son followed by rejected Stone/Cornerstone; outside-gate suffering followed by the city to come; and the user-reported blind-sight/lame-walk healing pair as a Gospel-sign comparator.

events.title: Tim/Father biblical deepening — Gardener / House / Key / Peg / Throne
events.subject: Tim / Potato / Father research
events.summary: A Tim/Father-first sweep identifies several high-density structures: John explicitly naming the Father as Gardener; the Davidic covenant binding House, Father, Son and throne; Eliakim combining fatherhood, Key of David, open/shut authority, secure peg/axis, throne and vessels; Hebrews distinguishing builder, House and Son-over-House; Paul's compression of God's field and building; Psalm 24's ascent/gates/King sequence; and Eden's center Tree, Four Rivers and stewardship.
